messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: HIGH - hosted-inference-prod | 504 spike from gateway (streaming endpoints). Policy: inference-primary -> 5m -> inference-secondary -> manager. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-1876543210
PagerDuty: Escalation policy fired: primary on-call Ben did not acknowledge within 2m. Paging secondary Tina and manager Emma.
Ben (on-call): sorry, just woke up, grabbing phone. can someone check if this is a regional problem or global?
Tina (secondary): acked. I'm on it, pulling logs now.
Alex (runtime): seeing repeated gateway 504s across us-west-2 and us-east-1. backend error from model-worker: "kv-cache-miss -> autoscaler failed to allocate: quota_exceeded". Posting logs:
```
[2026-02-28T03:20:12Z] gateway: upstream call failed status=504 id=txn_9f1a
[2026-02-28T03:20:13Z] worker-alloc: scale-request failed code=QuotaExceeded region=us-west-2 message="insufficient vgpu quota"
[2026-02-28T03:20:13Z] model-runtime: fallback to degraded cache=false
```
Maria (sre): hmm allocator getting 403 from cloud quota API? that sounds like a transient billing/quota fetch hiccup. can we force-scale while we investigate?
Tina (secondary): trying a manual scale to warm pool in us-east-1: `./infra/scale_pool --cluster=hosted-inference --region=us-east-1 --count=6 --force`
OpsBot: running command: ./infra/scale_pool --cluster=hosted-inference --region=us-east-1 --count=6 --force
OpsBot: result: ERROR: request failed with 403 Forbidden (quota API).
Tina (secondary): argh 403. I'll try bypassing autoscaler and spin dedicated instances via admin API.
Emma (SRE Lead): I'm creating a temporary bridge and alerting support rotations. If manager hop occurs, I'll join bridge. Creating bridge..
PagerDuty: Manager escalate: Emma paged (manager contact).
Emma (SRE Lead): Bridge created: https://meet.example/bridge/1876543210. Notifying CSM and Support for customer impact assessment.
Alex (runtime): quick note on impact: streaming endpoints are experiencing ~3% 504s globally but concentrated in US-W. P50 latency ok, P95 degraded (+1.8s). Potentially affecting inference-heavy customers on Dedicated and Hosted.
Ben (on-call): joining bridge in 2m. if quota API is 403, could it be a recent permission change to the service account? Who pushed infra-perms yesterday?
Maria (sre): I rotated infra service account key earlier for KMS roll but didn't touch quota perms. double-checking IAM audit..
Maria (sre): audit shows no recent role revokes. but cloud quota API returned 403 due to an internal rate-limit fallback. opening support ticket with cloud vendor.
Tina (secondary): workaround: redirect a portion of traffic away from gateway via feature-flag route /v2/stream -> fallback endpoint in eu-west to reduce pressure. applying patch: `traffic-router set-route --from /v2/stream --to fallback-eu-west --weight=30`
Alex (runtime): applied. monitoring logs for error drop.
OpsBot: router update applied: 30% traffic rerouted to fallback-eu-west.
PagerDuty: Note: escalation timer hit manager after 5m; manager acknowledged.
Emma (SRE Lead): updating incident severity: currently Sev2 (degraded service with customer-impact). Notified CSMs: they'll prepare outbound for customers with >1% errors.
Alex (runtime): logs: 504s dropped to 0.6% after route change, and autoscaler API calls retried succeeded in us-east-1: `allocated 6 vGPUs (was 2)`.
OpsBot: autoscaler event: scale completed -> instances=6 region=us-east-1.
Tina (secondary): confirming: workers back and streaming stability improving. still watching KV cache warm-up.
Ben (on-call): thanks all. I'll stay on at least 30m post-stable. Emma, do you want to keep manager bridge open?
Emma (SRE Lead): leave bridge open for 45m and do a quick postmortem draft. assign owners: Maria to investigate quota API errors and vendor interaction, Alex + Tina to document mitigation steps and traffic-router changes.
Maria (sre): noted. filing internal ticket: INFRA-5421 and vendor ticket CLOUD-9982.
Alex (runtime): adding runbook note: add retry/backoff for quota calls and fallback to cached quota.
IncidentBot: Pager resolved: HIGH - hosted-inference-prod | condition returned to normal. Page closed by Tina at 03:28:05 UTC.
Tina (secondary): closing thread notes: primary didn't ack in initial window causing escalation; recommend we add an explicit OOO override for primary to avoid unnecessary manager pages.
Emma (SRE Lead): +1 on OOO override, and schedule a tabletop for PD escalation policy next week. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
